Pins: v4 strap grant N/S/W + E face = strap q2 E (0.144 um) minus rq5/rr5 (results/arch/hbm_die_v16/vm_native_bank_grants_0600.json).

pin_regs.reason: COORDINATOR DECISION 2026-10-15 (keep the opt-out): this tile already satisfies OWNER RULE 19:50 (every input and every output registered at its pin) in RTL; a recipe-3 register would be a SECOND stage and add +2 VM edges (request +1, response +1) with no timing benefit. Evidence, rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_bank_static_strap.sv (the wrapper physical/hfd_vms_bank_strap_q*.sv is wiring only): INPUTS -- L118 bid/sid strap registers; L127 payload pin flops rq_d/wq_d/dq_d/kq_d/xq_d/x2_d/pq_d <= rq/wq/dq/kq/xq/xq2/pq; L128-133 valid pin flops rq_v/wq_v/dq_v/kq_v/xq_v/x2_v/pq_v; L183-186 slot pin flops rslot_d/wslot_d/rslot_v_d/wslot_v_d; rst_n only into the 3-flop reset relay (L107-112). OUTPUTS -- L135-141 rr = {rr_v, rr_d}, eg = {eg_v, eg_d}, pr = {pr_v, pr_d} are registers (rr_d L415, pr_d L416, eg_d L282, rr_v/pr_v/status L400-409); wq_done/dq_done/kq_done/xq_done/xq2_done are output reg (L44-52, set L337-343); status output reg (L56, L409). Recipe-2 keep_pin_regs + io_flop_at_pins anchor these flops at their pins; synthesized output-flop census: physical/audit_bank_output_flops.py.

floorplan_note: q2 identity2 --cts gate failed GPL-0305 (NaN) twice with the generated 3-macro column (20 um macro-macro channels, 5.4 um halos -> 9.5 um cell rows between arrays; overflow stuck at 0.115 for 12k iterations). Structural: the three arrays (pins only on W/E faces) form one abutted N-S stack (pitch = array height + 0.024 um) centred in the core, so no narrow inter-array channel exists; two ~70 um N/S channels carry the cross traffic.
